name: Kanou Seiji
source:
Seiji, married to [url=https://vndb.org/c77259]Atsu[/url], 20 years later. He is now a dad of a [url=https://vndb.org/c77260]big girl[/url] and a [url=https://vndb.org/c77261]little boy[/url].

He and Atsu decide to show to their children the place where they started their love story.
